title: Pure Adamancipator
summary: Adamancipator cards with generic staples. The Adamancipator Tuners Special Summon themselves from the hand and excavate the top five cards of the Deck to Special Summon a Level 4 or lower non-Tuner Rock, climbing rapidly into Level 6, 8 and 10 Synchros.

summary.title: Starters
points: Adamancipator Mates searches any Adamancipator monster from the Deck, and can return from the GY by placing a card from your hand on top of the Deck to stack an excavation.
Adamancipator Conductor places an Adamancipator card from the hand or GY on top of the Deck to Special Summon itself, guaranteeing a hit when it excavates five cards.
Adamancipator Researcher and Adamancipator Seeker Special Summon themselves from the hand while you control a Rock or an Adamancipator monster, giving you multiple excavations in one turn.

summary.title: Opening: Mates or Conductor + Any Tuner
steps: Activate Adamancipator Mates to search Adamancipator Conductor, or stack Adamancipator Crystal - Tiamite on top of the Deck with Conductor to Special Summon it.
Use Conductor to excavate the top five cards and Special Summon Crystal - Tiamite, which searches another Adamancipator card and Special Summons a Rock from your hand.
Special Summon Researcher or Seeker from the hand and excavate five more cards to summon a Level 4 Crystal, climbing into Adamancipator Risen - Leonite or Raptite at Level 6.
Extend through Raptite's excavation and Adamancipator Signs to finish on Adamancipator Risen - Dragite, Adamancipator Risen - Tiamite and Adamancipator Luminous.

summary.title: Crystals & Stacking
summary.text: Whenever an Adamancipator card Special Summons one of the Crystals, that Crystal triggers: Tiamite searches an Adamancipator card and summons a Rock from hand, Dragite draws a card, Leonite stacks an Adamancipator card on top of the Deck, and Raptite stacks a Rock on top. From the GY, Dragite, Leonite and Raptite return a matching WATER, FIRE or WIND Synchro to the Extra Deck to place themselves on top of the Deck for the next excavation.

summary.title: Synchro & Link Payoff
points: Adamancipator Risen - Tiamite (Level 10) searches an Adamancipator Spell/Trap on summon, and on the opponent's turn excavates to return opposing cards to the hand.
Adamancipator Risen - Dragite (Level 8) excavates five on your turn to bounce cards up to the Rocks revealed, and negates a Spell/Trap effect while a WATER monster is in your GY.
Adamancipator Risen - Leonite and Raptite (Level 6) excavate five to search or Special Summon a Rock, and revive or banish during the opponent's turn while FIRE or WIND monsters are in the GY.
Adamancipator Luminous (Link-2) summons Rock Tokens and places an opposing monster that activates an effect on top of the Deck.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Adamancipator Laputite boosts Rock stats and stacks up to five Adamancipator cards from the Deck on top in any order once per turn.
Adamancipator Signs revives any Rock in Defense Position and stacks a Level 4 or lower Rock on top of the Deck if it revived an Adamancipator.
Adamancipator Resonance is a Counter Trap searchable by Risen - Tiamite that negates a monster effect while you control an Adamancipator Synchro.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Block Dragon, the historic centerpiece of tournament Adamancipator builds, is Forbidden in the TCG. Non-Rock main deck cards are kept lean so excavations consistently hit Rocks.
